title: Partnership announcement
description: A partnership announcement in the Partnership Post tool's Laptop Dark look: the Massive × partner lockup on the laptop screen, with an eyebrow and the headline. Source: https://www.joinmassive.com/blog/crawl4ai-partner-spotlight (“Why Crawl4AI Named Massive Its Web Access Partner”, Sep 23, 2026); Crawl4AI logo from github.com/unclecode/crawl4ai (deploy/docker/static/assets/logo.png).

fields.label: Partner logo
fields.hint: The partner's own logo in white or light colours, PNG or SVG with a transparent background.

fields.label: Headline
fields.default: Crawl4AI named Massive its web access partner
fields.hint: What the partnership is; up to three lines, about 50 characters.

fields.label: Eyebrow
fields.hint: One or two words above the headline.
